scope: Research only, reuse cached frames and recordings; no new downloads, paid services, user actions, or production changes.

method.crop: PV11 fixed panels. Compare old nominal 52% right boundary to widened right boundary at 63%; widened crop starts x+4,y+3 and trims bottom 3. This is a right-boundary proxy on expanded crops, not a full old-vs-new segmentation trial.
method.foreground: Pixelwise temporal median by layout and slot; non-red mask ((R-G<45 or R-B<15) and max channel>45), trim first/last 3 rows; largest connected component. Imperfect proxy, especially red/dark/disconnected parts.
method.score: Foreground mean absolute BGR deviation from median plus 0.25 times background deviation; choose observed original image with minimum score, tie by run index. Laplacian mean squared response recorded as diagnostic only. No synthetic median reference registered.

labels.note: Same-recording evidence from a different observation channel, not independent battles. Individual labels, lineups and evidence images kept local, not published.

Largest non-red component misses red/disconnected portions and bright overlay artifacts; 0 touches does not prove no clipping. Fixed width/offset and thresholds fitted on existing frames; not universal.
